meaning:
συν-τρέχω
[in LXX: Psa.50:18 (עִם רָצָה), עִם רָצָה), 2Ma.2:1-32, Jdt.4.1-15 * ;]
to run together or with: before ἐκεῖ, Mrk.6:33; πρόσ, with accusative, Act.3:11; metaphorically, 1Pe.4:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming.
